caption: The drawing shows a textile design with a repeating pattern composed primarily of dark blue and off-white colors. In the center, there is a large symmetrical floral motif with a square frame enclosing a smaller floral figure. Surrounding the central motif are dense clusters of stylized flowers and leaves. Along the left and bottom edges, there are vertical and horizontal borders with repetitive urn or vase shapes, each flanked by ornate foliage. The upper right portion features a square section with a smaller geometric and floral repeated tile pattern. The bottom edge is finished with a row of tassel-like fringes drawn in alternating blue and white colors. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular space, with each border and section clearly delineated.
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
